name: redundancy-independence-check
description: Use when you are about to add a second agent, reviewer, judge or sample for safety, or to count agreement among several as confirmation. Redundancy is worth what the independence of its failures is worth. Agents that share a model tend to fail on the same cases, so multiplying their reliabilities over-credits the redundancy. Name what maker and checker share (model, brief, context, evidence, method), change a shared factor that matters, count checkers that share all of them as one vote, and prefer a deterministic check where one exists. Distinct from test-oracle-independence (tests written with the code in view) and execution-grounded-selection (choosing among candidates by running them). Backed by a preregistered co-failure evaluation (arxiv 2608.12895). Triggers on designing a verification step and on counting reviewer agreement.
